natural: Greedy for gain and never satisfied

meaning.en: Insatiably greedy.
meaning.zh: 贪心永远没有满足的时候。

examples.zh: 他贪得无厌，最终落入法网。
examples.en: His insatiable greed eventually landed him in jail.

examples.zh: 对贪得无厌的人，不能一再让步。
examples.en: You can't keep giving in to insatiably greedy people.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. 厌 = 餍 (satisfied).

natural: Looking with different eyes

meaning.en: To see someone in a different (usually better) light; to treat differently.
meaning.zh: 用另一种眼光看待。指不按一般情况对待，多指看重。

examples.zh: 他这次的表现让老板另眼相看。
examples.en: His performance this time made the boss see him in a new light.

examples.zh: 不能因为出身而对人另眼相看。
examples.en: You shouldn't treat people differently because of their background.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，多指看重，也指歧视。

antonyms: 门缝里看人——把人看扁了

natural: Changing back and forth without constancy

meaning.en: Fickle; constantly changing one's mind.
meaning.zh: 一会儿这样，一会儿那样，变化不定。

examples.zh: 他反复无常，让人捉摸不透。
examples.en: He's so fickle you can never tell what he'll do.

examples.zh: 最近天气反复无常。
examples.en: The weather has been very changeable lately.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. People or weather.

synonyms: 早晨的天，婆婆的脸——说变就变

natural: A crane standing among chickens

meaning.en: To stand head and shoulders above others.
meaning.zh: 像鹤站在鸡群中一样。比喻一个人的仪表或才能在周围一群人里显得很突出。

examples.zh: 他个子高，站在人群里鹤立鸡群。
examples.en: He's tall and stands out above the crowd.

examples.zh: 她的作品在比赛中鹤立鸡群。
examples.en: Her work stood head and shoulders above the rest in the competition.

story.en: Someone remarked that Ji Shao, son of the poet Ji Kang, stood out in a crowd "like a wild crane among chickens" (如野鹤之在鸡群).
story.zh: 有人说嵇绍"昂昂然如野鹤之在鸡群"。

natural: Killing the hen to get the eggs

meaning.en: To sacrifice long-term gain for short-term profit.
meaning.zh: 杀了鸡去取蛋。比喻只图眼前的好处而不顾长远利益。

equivalents: kill the goose that lays the golden eggs

examples.zh: 过度开采资源无异于杀鸡取卵。
examples.en: Over-exploiting resources is killing the goose that lays the golden eggs.

examples.zh: 对企业乱收费是杀鸡取卵的做法。
examples.en: Imposing arbitrary fees on businesses is short-sighted.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Compare Aesop's goose that laid the golden eggs.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。可比较《伊索寓言》下金蛋的鹅。

synonyms: 沙锅里捣蒜——一锤子买卖

natural: Better to go without than accept poor quality

meaning.en: Quality over quantity; better none than bad ones.
meaning.zh: 宁可缺少一些，也不要不顾质量一味求多。

equivalents: hold out for the right one

examples.zh: 招聘人才要宁缺毋滥。
examples.en: When hiring, quality matters more than quantity.

examples.zh: 找对象她坚持宁缺毋滥。
examples.en: In dating, she'd rather wait for the right person than settle.

natural: Weighed down by layers of worries

meaning.en: Weighed down with worries; preoccupied.
meaning.zh: 心里有很多忧虑的事。

equivalents: have a lot on one's mind

examples.zh: 他这几天心事重重，饭也吃不下。
examples.en: He's had a lot on his mind lately and can't eat.

examples.zh: 看她心事重重的样子，我没敢多问。
examples.en: She looked so troubled that I didn't dare ask.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. 重 is chóng.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。"重"读 chóng。

natural: Too weak to stand a breeze

meaning.en: Frail and delicate.
meaning.zh: 形容身体娇弱，连风吹都经受不起。

equivalents: a puff of wind would blow them over

examples.zh: 她看起来弱不禁风，其实很能吃苦。
examples.en: She looks frail, but she's actually very tough.

examples.zh: 大病一场后，他变得弱不禁风。
examples.en: After a serious illness he became very frail.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. 禁 is jīn (bear).
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。"禁"读 jīn。

antonyms: 孙悟空进了八卦炉——越炼越结实

natural: Regretting not having done otherwise at the start

meaning.en: To regret what one did in the first place.
meaning.zh: 后悔当初不该这样做或没有那样做。

examples.zh: 他染上赌瘾，现在悔不当初。
examples.en: He got addicted to gambling and now rues the day.

examples.zh: 没好好学习，现在悔不当初。
examples.en: I didn't study properly and now I wish I had.

natural: Knowing what's enough brings constant happiness

meaning.en: Contentment brings happiness.
meaning.zh: 知道满足，就总是快乐的。

equivalents: enough is as good as a feast

examples.zh: 爷爷常说知足常乐。
examples.en: Grandpa always says contentment is the key to happiness.

examples.zh: 她知足常乐，从不抱怨。
examples.en: She counts her blessings and never complains.

story.en: Laozi: "There is no greater calamity than not knowing what is enough... the contentment of knowing enough is lasting contentment" (知足之足，常足矣).
story.zh: 《老子》："祸莫大于不知足……故知足之足，常足矣。"

date.zh: 春秋末至战国 · 前6—前4世纪
date.en: late Spring and Autumn to Warring States, 6th–4th c. BC

natural: Peaches and plums everywhere under heaven

meaning.en: (Of a teacher) to have students all over the world.
meaning.zh: 比喻学生很多，各地都有。

examples.zh: 王老师教了四十年书，桃李满天下。
examples.en: After forty years of teaching, Ms Wang has students all over the world.

examples.zh: 祝老师桃李满天下！
examples.en: Wishing our teacher students everywhere!

usage.en: Predicate. 桃李 is a metaphor for students. Common on Teachers' Day.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。"桃李"比喻学生。教师节常用。

natural: Throwing stones on someone who has fallen down a well

meaning.en: To kick someone when they're down.
meaning.zh: 看见人掉进井里，不但不救，反而扔石头。比喻乘人危急时加以陷害。

equivalents: hit a man when he's down

examples.zh: 他失势后，以前的朋友纷纷落井下石。
examples.en: After his fall, his former friends kicked him while he was down.

examples.zh: 别人有难时，不要落井下石。
examples.en: Don't kick people when they're down.

story.en: Han Yu lamented false friends who, when someone "falls into a pit, won't lift a hand to save him but push him further and drop stones on him".
story.zh: 韩愈《柳子厚墓志铭》："落陷阱，不一引手救，反挤之，又下石焉者，皆是也。"

natural: Each doing what they think right

meaning.en: Each going their own way; lack of coordination.
meaning.zh: 各自按照自己认为对的去做。形容思想、行动不一致。

examples.zh: 团队成员各行其是，项目一团糟。
examples.en: The team members all did their own thing, and the project was a mess.

examples.zh: 各部门不能各行其是，要统一行动。
examples.en: Departments mustn't pull in different directions — they need to act together.

natural: Pushing the boat along with the current

meaning.en: To go with the flow; to take advantage of circumstances.
meaning.zh: 顺着水流的方向推船。比喻顺着某个趋势或方式说话办事。

examples.zh: 既然大家都同意，我就顺水推舟答应了。
examples.en: Since everyone agreed, I went with the flow and said yes.

examples.zh: 他顺水推舟，把责任推给了别人。
examples.en: He took advantage of the situation to shift the blame.

synonyms: 诸葛亮借东风——巧借天时

natural: A craftsman's mind applied uniquely

meaning.en: Showing great originality and ingenuity.
meaning.zh: 独特地运用精巧的心思。指在技术或艺术方面创造性的构思。

examples.zh: 这座园林的设计匠心独运。
examples.en: The garden's design is ingenious.

examples.zh: 作者匠心独运，用倒叙手法讲述故事。
examples.en: The author inventively tells the story in flashback.

natural: Touching stone and turning it to gold

meaning.en: The Midas touch; to turn something ordinary into something fine.
meaning.zh: 原指神仙用法术使石头变成金子。比喻把不好的或平凡的东西改成很好的东西。

examples.zh: 经过老师点石成金的修改，这篇文章大为增色。
examples.en: With the teacher's Midas-touch edits, the essay was transformed.

examples.zh: 好的设计师能点石成金。
examples.en: A good designer can work wonders.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. From Daoist legends of immortals turning stone into gold.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。源自道家神仙传说。

natural: A flock of dragons without a leader

meaning.en: Leaderless; a group without a leader.
meaning.zh: 一群龙没有领头的。比喻一伙人中没有领头的。

examples.zh: 经理辞职后，部门群龙无首。
examples.en: After the manager resigned, the department was leaderless.

examples.zh: 球队队长受伤，一时群龙无首。
examples.en: With the captain injured, the team was suddenly rudderless.

story.en: The Book of Changes: "Seeing a flock of dragons without a head — auspicious" (见群龙无首，吉). Originally a good omen of equality; now means lacking leadership.
story.zh: 《周易·乾》："见群龙无首，吉。"原为吉兆，现指缺乏领导。

date.zh: 西周至战国 · 前9—前3世纪
date.en: Western Zhou to Warring States, 9th–3rd c. BC

usage.en: Predicate. In 《周易·乾》“见群龙无首，吉” the phrase is auspicious; the modern negative sense is a later reversal.

natural: Wind, flowers, snow and moon

meaning.en: Romantic but frivolous themes; love affairs and idle pleasures.
meaning.zh: 原指四时景色。后指堆砌辞藻、内容空洞的诗文，或男女情爱之事。

examples.zh: 他的诗大多写风花雪月，内容空洞。
examples.en: His poems are mostly about romance and scenery, with little substance.

examples.zh: 年轻时谈谈风花雪月，老了才知道生活不易。
examples.en: When young we talk of romance; only when old do we see how hard life is.

usage.en: Subject or object. A classic cultural set of four scenic images.

natural: Defeated once and smeared on the ground

meaning.en: A crushing defeat; to fail utterly.
meaning.zh: 一旦失败就肝脑涂地。形容失败到了不可收拾的地步。

examples.zh: 这次投资一败涂地，他损失了全部积蓄。
examples.en: The investment failed miserably, and he lost all his savings.

examples.zh: 决赛中他们一败涂地。
examples.en: They suffered a crushing defeat in the final.

story.en: When asked to lead the rebellion, Liu Bang hesitated: "If the leader is not good, one defeat and our brains will be smeared on the ground" (今置将不善，一败涂地).
story.zh: 刘邦说："天下方扰，诸侯并起，今置将不善，一败涂地。"

usage.en: Predicate. In speech 一 is yí.

natural: Rain falling in torrents

meaning.en: A torrential downpour.
meaning.zh: 形容雨下得很大。

examples.zh: 外面大雨滂沱，我们只好待在家里。
examples.en: It's pouring outside, so we'll have to stay in.

examples.zh: 在大雨滂沱中，他依然坚持跑完了全程。
examples.en: In the torrential rain, he still finished the whole race.

natural: Driving far and straight in

meaning.en: To drive deep into enemy territory unopposed.
meaning.zh: 军队不停顿地向远方挺进。形容进军迅速，毫无阻挡。

examples.zh: 敌军长驱直入，直逼首都。
examples.en: The enemy drove deep unopposed, heading straight for the capital.

examples.zh: 外国品牌长驱直入，占领了国内市场。
examples.en: Foreign brands swept in and took over the domestic market.

natural: A branch growing outside the node

meaning.en: To create unexpected complications.
meaning.zh: 在不该生枝的地方长出枝条。比喻在原有问题外又岔出了新问题。

equivalents: throw a spanner in the works

examples.zh: 合同快签了，没想到又节外生枝。
examples.en: We were about to sign when an unexpected snag came up.

examples.zh: 这件事简单处理，别节外生枝。
examples.en: Deal with this simply — don't complicate matters.

natural: Returning home dressed in brocade

meaning.en: To return home in glory after making good.
meaning.zh: 穿着锦绣衣服回到家乡。指富贵以后回到故乡，含有向乡里夸耀的意思。

examples.zh: 他在外打拼多年，终于衣锦还乡。
examples.en: After years of hard work away, he finally returned home a success.

examples.zh: 奥运冠军衣锦还乡，受到热烈欢迎。
examples.en: The Olympic champion received a hero's welcome on returning home.

usage.en: Predicate. 衣 is yì (to wear) in classical reading; usually yī in modern speech.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。"衣"作动词，古读 yì，今多读 yī。

natural: A reputation trampled like a wolf's bedding

meaning.en: Notorious; with a ruined reputation.
meaning.zh: 形容名声极坏。

examples.zh: 这家公司因造假丑闻声名狼藉。
examples.en: The company became notorious after the fraud scandal.

examples.zh: 他贪污受贿，弄得声名狼藉。
examples.en: His corruption left his reputation in tatters.

usage.en: Predicate. 狼藉 = scattered and trampled (like a wolf's bedding).
usage.zh: 多作谓语。"狼藉"指杂乱不堪。

natural: Carved beams and painted rafters

meaning.en: Ornately carved and painted (of traditional buildings).
meaning.zh: 指有彩绘装饰的华丽建筑。

examples.zh: 这座古寺雕梁画栋，十分壮观。
examples.en: The ancient temple, with its carved and painted beams, is magnificent.

examples.zh: 大宅院雕梁画栋，显示出主人的财富。
examples.en: The mansion's ornate beams show off its owner's wealth.
